expected="".join("".join(p.itertext()) for p in []); body=[]; [body.extend([v] if t=="p" else [s for row in v for c in row for s in c]) for t,v in bb]; target=clean(text); missing=[s for s in body if clean(s) not in target]; print("PDF_PAGES",text.count(chr(12)),"MISSING_BLOCKS",missing); print("PDF_FULL_TEXT",text)'
